## Understanding WheelMates Co-op Gameplay

WheelMates is designed specifically as a two-player co-op driving adventure. The game centers on players controlling tiny RC cars to explore the oversized house of the missing Professor Everett Bloom. Because the game is built entirely around a shared experience, there is no single-player mode; you and your co-op buddy must work together to solve puzzles, navigate the environment, and uncover the mystery behind the scientist's disappearance.

The game supports two primary ways to play: online co-op or split-screen on the couch. This flexibility ensures that whether you are in the same room or playing from different locations, you can enjoy the adventure together at your own pace.

## The Friends Pass System

One of the most important aspects of the WheelMates multiplayer experience is the inclusion of a Friends Pass. This feature is designed to make it easy for players to connect with their friends without requiring both parties to purchase a copy of the game.

With the Friends Pass, only one player needs to own the full game to host a session and invite a partner to play. This removes the barrier to entry for your co-op buddy, allowing you to fasten your seatbelts and begin your exploration of the house immediately without needing additional financial commitments from your teammate.

## Gameplay Mechanics and Exploration

As you explore the house, you will rely on your tiny size and a series of unlockable abilities to traverse difficult areas. The game focuses on puzzle-solving and exploration rather than combat, turning the house itself into the primary challenge. 

Key traversal mechanics mentioned in the official gameplay overview include:

*   **Magnetic Wheels:** These allow players to drive onto walls and ceilings, opening up new paths in previously explored rooms.
*   **Rope:** Used to bridge gaps between objects and furniture.
*   **Magnetic Grabber:** A versatile tool that players can use creatively to solve the many puzzles hidden throughout the laboratory-like house.

As you progress, returning to earlier rooms with newly unlocked abilities is encouraged. This often reveals hidden paths and new story clues that were previously inaccessible.

## Customization and Mini Games

Beyond the main puzzle-solving narrative, WheelMates allows players to personalize their experience. You can customize your tiny four-wheeled hero by collecting car parts and new colors while you explore.

If you and your partner want to take a break from the main story, you can engage in various mini games found throughout the house. These side activities provide a perfect opportunity to show off your driving skills and compete against your co-op buddy to see who truly is the better driver. All progress and story fragments you discover are conveniently tracked in a narrative journal, helping you piece together the history of Professor Bloom's home.

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Can I play WheelMates by myself?**
No, WheelMates is built specifically for two-player co-op. You must have a partner to play the game.

**Does the game support split-screen play?**
Yes, WheelMates supports both split-screen play on the couch and online co-op.

**How does the Friends Pass work?**
The Friends Pass allows one person who owns the game to invite a friend to play with them. Only one copy of the game is required for two people to play together.

**Is there combat in WheelMates?**
No, there is no combat in the game. The core gameplay revolves around driving, puzzle-solving, and exploration.
